metadata.case_name: FONG MO FUNG v. WONG YICK YING

plaintiff.occupation_before: casual worker carrying out indoor decoration work
plaintiff.occupation_after: occasional work earning about $1,000 - $3,000 a month
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: security guard (had obtained certificate but unable to find such work)

injuries.description: left lower lid full thickness lacerations
source: (a) 8 cm laceration over left face involving left lower eyelid;
left lower lid full thickness lacerations.
injuries.icd_description: Open wound of eyelid or periocular area
Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: deep laceration over left wrist with tendon injury; superficial branch of ulnar nerve cut; ulnar artery cut; flexor carpi ulnaris tendon cut
source: (d) deep laceration over left wrist with tendon injury and numbness over left little finger;
left wrist laceration resulting in superficial branch of ulnar nerve cut, ulnar artery cut, and flexor carpi ulnaris tendon cut.
Operation was carried out on 14 October 2006 to repair the deltoid, superficial branch of ulnar nerve, ulnar artery and flexor carpi ulnaris tendon.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple sites of wrist
Laceration without foreign body of shoulder or upper arm
Laceration without foreign body of shoulder or upper arm

manifestations.description: on-and-off pain and itchiness and intermittent tearing in the left eye
mild lid notching and cicatricial ectropion
reduced vision in the left eye
left eye scarring, pain, frequent eye discharge and wide visual disturbance
left hand weakness; weaker wrist and handgrip power
increased sensation over the ulnar side of the left hand and fingers consistent with incomplete recovery of the superficial branch of the ulnar nerve
left wrist scarring, pain, weakness, numbness and stiffness
left ear and left arm pain and scarring

treatments_received: Operation was carried out on 14 October 2006 to repair the deltoid, superficial branch of ulnar nerve, ulnar artery and flexor carpi ulnaris tendon.
Operation repair the eyelid was done on the day of the accident (i.e., 14 October 2006).
Wrist extension splint was applied from 14 October 2006 until 6 November 2006.
Physiotherapy treatment from 8 November 2006 to 19 March 2007.
Occupational therapy treatment from 13 November 2006 to 9 November 2007.

losses.description: Left wrist scarring, pain, weakness, numbness and stiffness; tendon, nerve and artery injuries to the left wrist
Left eye scarring and left ear/left arm scarring

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Before the accident he used to go hiking and swimming. He cannot do swimming now and has reduced activity of hiking.
He has studied a course on security guards and is granted a certificate but he cannot find a job as a security guard.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Lai Po v. Au Wai Kit
comparable_cases.injury_description: Madam Chan suffers from left traumatic 3rd nerve palsy. She has double vision and photophobia. Further, there are restricted extra-ocular movements of her left eye. Based solely on the condition of her eye, Madam Chan’s expert considered that the level of permanent impairment of the whole person is 34%, based on 30% impairment of the whole visual system.

comparable_cases.case_name: Yan Chui Sim v. Paul Y ITC General Contractors Limited & Others
comparable_cases.injury_description: Apart from the orthopaedic injury and disability, the Plaintiff also suffered from depression and there have been psychiatric reports produced showing that she suffered from post traumatic stress disorder as a result of the accident.
